data.one_liner: Adaptive screen and font scaling with CSS-like breakpoints and container-aware layouts.
data.what_it_does: Scales UI elements, text sizes, and padding based on design draft dimensions and screen constraints. Provides CSS-like media query breakpoints, SwiftUI-style size classes, and nested layout scoping.
use_when: You need to adapt layouts and font sizes across different mobile and desktop screen dimensions
You want CSS-like breakpoints or SwiftUI-style size classes for responsive Flutter UI
You require container-aware responsive panes via LayoutScope
avoid_when: You are using the standard material library and cannot migrate your app imports to the standalone material_ui package
You prefer pure Flutter layout primitives without third-party scaling extensions
strengths: Comprehensive suite of responsive extensions, widgets, and breakpoint builders
Performance optimized with optional autoRebuild: false and context-aware extensions
Container-aware LayoutScope for nested panes and sidebars
weaknesses: Requires switching Material imports to the standalone material_ui package
Strict SDK constraints requiring Dart 3.13+ and Flutter 3.47+
data.setup_notes: Requires adding package, importing material_ui instead of standard material, and wrapping the app with ScreenUtilPlusInit.

alternatives.name: flutter_screenutil
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want standard screen adaptation without replacing standard Flutter Material imports or package constraints.
